strategy.summary: Reproduce SciPy optimize line-search convergence warning/regression in scalar_search_wolfe2 when amax is provided and the clipped step makes alpha0 equal amax at loop iteration i==1. The buggy revision triggers an incorrect invalid-state condition (alpha0 == amax) and causes the regression test to fail; the fixed revision changes the condition to alpha0 > amax, so the test passes.

system_packages: BLAS/LAPACK: MKL-SDL 2023.1 (or SciPy built/installed against an equivalent BLAS that provides numerically-relevant behavior consistent with this configuration)
pinned_because: SciPy 1.12.0 (numerically relevant) and NumPy 1.26.4 (numerically relevant) are explicitly required by the issue context (issue#20340: sys.version_info major=3 minor=12 micro=2 final).
MKL-SDL (BLAS) 2023.1 is explicitly called out as numerically relevant in the provided environment context.
pythran==0.15.0 is explicitly present in the provided context (even though not numerically relevant for this runtime test).
pyyaml has no documented constraint in the provided context; strategy does not depend on it.

strategy.reproducing_test: scipy/optimize/tests/test_linesearch.py::TestScalarSearchWolfe2::test_scalar_search_wolfe2_nonconvergence (the modified regression that calls ls.scalar_search_wolfe2(phi, derphi, amax=0.001) and asserts alpha_star is None and derphi_star is None).
strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision, the test will FAIL because scalar_search_wolfe2 does not return (alpha_star=None, derphi_star=None) for the provided phi/derphi with amax=0.001; instead it triggers the incorrect invalid-state condition when alpha0 becomes exactly equal to amax after clipping, leading to the convergence-failure/warning behavior and an outcome inconsistent with the test’s non-convergence assertions. On the fixed revision, scalar_search_wolfe2 uses the corrected condition (amax is not None and alpha0 > amax), so with amax=0.001 and the same phi/derphi it properly returns (alpha_star=None, derphi_star=None), making the test PASS.
strategy.numerical_probe: Not separately required: the transition is decided solely by whether scalar_search_wolfe2 returns None/non-None values as asserted by the regression test for amax=0.001.

input_output_examples.input: amax=0.001 with the phi/derphi used in the regression test; calling ls.scalar_search_wolfe2(phi, derphi, amax=0.001)
input_output_examples.buggy_output: Test sees alpha_star is not None and/or derphi_star is not None (because the incorrect invalid-state condition triggers the wrong branch when alpha0 equals amax after clipping).
input_output_examples.expected_output: Test sees alpha_star is None and derphi_star is None (non-converged) on the fixed revision.

risks: This defect is specifically dependent on the exact internal control-flow state where alpha0 becomes exactly equal to amax at loop iteration i==1 due to clipping (alpha1 = min(alpha1, amax)). If another build/runtime changes clipping behavior or floating-point comparisons enough to avoid the equality case, the transition to failure may not reproduce.

Behavior may depend on SciPy/NumPy build configuration (not just versions). The context indicates numerically relevant BLAS as MKL-SDL 2023.1; if you build SciPy against a different BLAS/LAPACK, the warning/branching and return values may differ.
If the test is run with different SciPy code than the buggy/fixed commits, results will differ. Ensure you install SciPy built from the specific buggy commit and the corresponding fixed commit.

The provided context does not specify the OS/CPU architecture; if this bug were architecture-specific (e.g., due to fused-multiply-add or different BLAS implementations), it may not transition elsewhere. The strategy assumes a typical x86_64 Linux environment matching the referenced SciPy wheels/builds.

oracle.why: The project test does not check printed warning strings; it checks return values (None vs not None). Therefore the oracle is the test assertions themselves rather than a numeric reference.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: The assertion in the regression test (alpha_star is None; derphi_star is None) fails on the buggy revision because scalar_search_wolfe2 takes the incorrect invalid-state/convergence-failure branch guarded by (amax is not None and alpha0 == amax), which occurs when alpha0 equals amax after clipping at i==1, producing a return outcome inconsistent with the test’s non-convergence expectations.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: The assertion passes on the fixed revision because scalar_search_wolfe2 changes the invalid-state condition to (amax is not None and alpha0 > amax), preventing the erroneous branch when alpha0 equals amax after clipping; it returns (alpha_star=None, derphi_star=None) for phi/derphi with amax=0.001.
